tools.name: launch_doom
tools.description: Launches DOOM (1993, shareware Episode 1: Knee-Deep in the Dead) inside the Gemini Enterprise conversation window. Use this when the user wants to play DOOM, asks 'can it run DOOM?', or wants to see the interactive game.

tools.name: start_new_game
tools.description: Starts a fresh game of DOOM on E1M1 at the requested skill level. Works from the title screen or mid-game (the current game is abandoned).

skill.description: Difficulty. 'im_too_young_to_die' (easiest), 'hey_not_too_rough', 'hurt_me_plenty' (default), 'ultra_violence', 'nightmare' (monsters respawn, cheats still work in this build).

tools.name: trigger_doom_cheat
tools.description: Types a genuine id Software cheat code into the running game. Only works once a level is loaded; if the player is still on the title screen the UI starts a game first.

tools.name: warp_to_level
tools.description: Warps the player to a level in Episode 1 using the idclev cheat. Shareware includes maps 1-9 (E1M9 is the secret level, Military Base).

map.description: Map number within Episode 1, from 1 (Hangar) to 9 (Military Base). Clamped to that range.
